model_output.rationale: All three lines carry OA-22 ("another payer is primary"). The 271 returns EB*R for Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." The claim was filed SBR*P to Keystone (CI). Claim-level MOA MA04 confirms primary payer adjudication data is missing — because it was never billed to Medicare first.

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed SBR*P to Keystone Commercial; 271 EB*R shows Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS is primary. OA-22 on all three lines confirms Keystone is secondary.

next_action.detail: Bill Medicare Part B (Novitas Solutions, NPI/PI 1846349352) as primary first. Then rebill Keystone as secondary with Medicare's EOB/adjudication data in SBR/AMT/CAS loops to satisfy MA04.

evidence.fact: CAS*OA*22 on all three service lines; MOA MA04 at claim level — another payer is primary and primary adjudication data is absent
evidence.locator: CAS segments under each SVC; MOA***MA04

evidence.fact: EB*R for Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS with MSG 'PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER'; EB*1 (active) for Keystone as secondary
evidence.locator: EB*R loop, NM1*PR*2*NOVITAS SOLUTIONS MEDICARE PART B, MSG segment

evidence.fact: SBR*P*18*******CI — claim filed with Keystone as primary payer

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; MA04 on rebill to Keystone requires primary adjudication data in SBR/AMT/CAS loops
CARC 22: care may be covered by another payer per COB — bill primary, then secondary
